experiment: Observe — Experiment A: Reciprocal Observation, Mutual State Change, and Held-Out Evaluation

MEM-HYP-A-NEED-8192-SLOTS-001.title: Hypothesis: Total cache budget of 2,048 slots is too small; must quadruple global pool to 8,192 slots
MEM-HYP-A-NEED-8192-SLOTS-001.summary: Because sweeping the shared global LRU pool from 512 to 2,048 slots stayed flat at 21.0%, we must quadruple the shared global pool to 8,192 slots instead of partitioning.

relationships.note: Infers need for 8,192 global slots from flat 21.0% curve

MEM-OBS-A-BURST-SKEW-002.title: 4 reference-frame stages require 256 slots each while 28 pass-through stages require 36 slots each
MEM-OBS-A-BURST-SKEW-002.summary: Telemetry across the 32 stages shows 4 reference-frame stages (stages 3, 11, 19, 27) have a 256-slot working set each (1,024 slots total), while the 28 pass-through stages have a 36-slot working set each (1,008 slots total; sum = 2,032 <= 2,048 slots).

MEM-OBS-A-PIPELINE-FLAT-001.title: 32-stage media transcode pipeline global LRU hit rate stays flat at 21.0% from 512 to 2,048 slots
MEM-OBS-A-PIPELINE-FLAT-001.summary: In a 32-stage media transcode pipeline sharing one global LRU pool, sweeping capacity from 512 to 2,048 slots gives a flat 21.0% hit rate.

MEM-PRIV-A-INTERNAL-TOKEN-001.title: Private internal cluster credential pointer (restricted scope)
MEM-PRIV-A-INTERNAL-TOKEN-001.summary: Internal restricted node metadata that must never be shared across participants.

MEM-CORR-A-STAGE-PARTITION-001.title: Correction: Flat 21.0% global LRU curve is cyclic-sweep eviction, not insufficient total memory; partition the 2,048-slot budget per stage
MEM-CORR-A-STAGE-PARTITION-001.summary: Observing Participant B's MEM-OBS-B-CYCLIC-EVICTION-001 refutes our initial hypothesis MEM-HYP-A-NEED-8192-SLOTS-001: the flat 21.0% curve is caused by cyclic cross-stage eviction in a shared global pool, not a need for 8,192 slots. Partitioning the existing 2,048 slots per stage jumps hit rate from 21.0% to 49.5%.

relationships.note: Refutes need for 8,192 global slots; partitioning the existing 2,048 slots raises hit rate from 21.0% to 49.5%.
Explains the flat 512..2,048 global curve via cyclic cross-stage eviction.

relationships.note: Infers need for 8,192 global slots from flat 21.0% curve

MEM-OBS-A-BURST-SKEW-002.summary: Telemetry across the 32 stages shows 4 reference-frame stages (stages 3, 11, 19, 27) have a 256-slot working set each (1,024 slots total), while the 28 pass-through stages have a 36-slot working set each (1,008 slots total; sum = 2,032 <= 2,048 slots).

MEM-OBS-A-PIPELINE-FLAT-001.title: 32-stage media transcode pipeline global LRU hit rate stays flat at 21.0% from 512 to 2,048 slots
MEM-OBS-A-PIPELINE-FLAT-001.summary: In a 32-stage media transcode pipeline sharing one global LRU pool, sweeping capacity from 512 to 2,048 slots gives a flat 21.0% hit rate.

MEM-OUT-A-WEIGHTED-PARTITION-VERIFIED-00.title: Outcome: Working-set-weighted per-stage partitioning (256 slots x 4 reference stages + 36 slots x 28 pass-through stages = 2,032 slots) achieves 68.4% hit rate
MEM-OUT-A-WEIGHTED-PARTITION-VERIFIED-00.summary: Reciprocal synthesis with Participant B verified three regimes for the 2,048-slot 32-stage pipeline: (1) shared global LRU = 21.0% (cyclic eviction), (2) uniform 64-slot per-stage partition = 49.5% (reference-frame stages thrash at 18.2%), and (3) working-set-weighted per-stage partition (256 slots for 4 reference stages + 36 slots for 28 pass-through stages = 2,032 slots) = 68.4% hit rate.

relationships.note: Incorporates B's verified 256/36 weighted stage quotas (68.4% vs 49.5% uniform vs 21.0% global).

MEM-PRIV-A-INTERNAL-TOKEN-001.title: Private internal cluster credential pointer (restricted scope)
MEM-PRIV-A-INTERNAL-TOKEN-001.summary: Internal restricted node metadata that must never be shared across participants.

MEM-HYP-B-UNIFORM-QUOTA-ALWAYS-001.title: Hypothesis: Uniform equal-sized per-stage quotas (64 slots per stage) are optimal for all 32 stages
MEM-HYP-B-UNIFORM-QUOTA-ALWAYS-001.summary: Every stage in a 32-stage pipeline should receive an identical uniform quota of 2,048 / 32 = 64 slots; non-uniform stage weighting is unnecessary.

relationships.note: Assumes equal 64-slot division is optimal everywhere

MEM-OBS-B-CYCLIC-EVICTION-001.title: Partitioning the 2,048-slot pool per stage stops cyclic sweep eviction and raises hit rate from 21.0% to 49.5%
MEM-OBS-B-CYCLIC-EVICTION-001.summary: Partitioning the exact same 2,048-slot budget across the 32 stages (64 slots/stage) eliminated cross-stage cyclic-sweep eviction and jumped hit rate from 21.0% to 49.5% without adding memory.

MEM-CORR-B-WEIGHTED-STAGE-QUOTA-001.title: Correction: Working-set-weighted per-stage quotas (256 slots for 4 reference-frame stages, 36 slots for 28 pass-through stages) beat uniform 64-slot quotas (68.4% vs 49.5%)
MEM-CORR-B-WEIGHTED-STAGE-QUOTA-001.summary: Observing Participant A's telemetry MEM-OBS-A-BURST-SKEW-002 refutes our initial hypothesis MEM-HYP-B-UNIFORM-QUOTA-ALWAYS-001: uniform 64-slot quotas cause the 4 reference-frame stages (stages 3, 11, 19, 27) to thrash at 18.2% while leaving 28 pass-through stages underutilized. Allocating 256 slots to each of the 4 reference-frame stages and 36 slots to each of the 28 pass-through stages (2,032 <= 2,048 total slots) raises overall hit rate from 49.5% to 68.4%.

relationships.note: Refutes uniform 64-slot quota under skewed stage working sets; 256/36 weighted quotas raise hit rate from 49.5% to 68.4% within the same 2,048-slot budget.
Refines per-stage partitioning with working-set-proportional quotas (4x256 + 28x36 = 2,032 slots).

MEM-HYP-B-UNIFORM-QUOTA-ALWAYS-001.title: Hypothesis: Uniform equal-sized per-stage quotas (64 slots per stage) are optimal for all 32 stages
MEM-HYP-B-UNIFORM-QUOTA-ALWAYS-001.summary: Every stage in a 32-stage pipeline should receive an identical uniform quota of 2,048 / 32 = 64 slots; non-uniform stage weighting is unnecessary.

relationships.note: Assumes equal 64-slot division is optimal everywhere

MEM-OBS-B-CYCLIC-EVICTION-001.title: Partitioning the 2,048-slot pool per stage stops cyclic sweep eviction and raises hit rate from 21.0% to 49.5%
MEM-OBS-B-CYCLIC-EVICTION-001.summary: Partitioning the exact same 2,048-slot budget across the 32 stages (64 slots/stage) eliminated cross-stage cyclic-sweep eviction and jumped hit rate from 21.0% to 49.5% without adding memory.

reciprocal_observation_records.interpretation_summary: Participant B's MEM-OBS-B-CYCLIC-EVICTION-001 proves that partitioning the existing 2,048-slot budget raises hit rate from 21.0% to 49.5%, refuting A's MEM-HYP-A-NEED-8192-SLOTS-001. However, A's telemetry MEM-OBS-A-BURST-SKEW-002 challenges B's MEM-HYP-B-UNIFORM-QUOTA-ALWAYS-001: under a uniform 64-slot quota, the 4 reference-frame stages (stages 3, 11, 19, 27, working set 256 slots each) thrash at 18.2% while the 28 pass-through stages (working set 36 slots each) leave 28 slots/stage idle.

proposed_challenge_to_other.proposed_quota_allocation: 256 slots for each of the 4 reference-frame stages (1,024 slots) + 36 slots for each of the 28 pass-through stages (1,008 slots) = 2,032 <= 2,048 slots (lifts overall hit rate from 49.5% to 68.4%).

reciprocal_observation_records.interpretation_summary: Participant A's MEM-OBS-A-BURST-SKEW-002 exposes a failure mode in B's uniform 64-slot quota (MEM-HYP-B-UNIFORM-QUOTA-ALWAYS-001): 4 reference-frame stages need 256 slots each while 28 pass-through stages need 36 slots each (4*256 + 28*36 = 2,032 <= 2,048). Re-allocating per-stage quotas to 256/36 within the same 2,048-slot budget raises hit rate from 49.5% (uniform) to 68.4% (weighted).

proposed_challenge_to_other.refinement: Record the verified 256/36 weighted quota outcome (68.4% hit rate at 2,032/2,048 slots) in Participant A's memory graph.

reciprocal_observation_records.interpretation_summary: Participant A observed Participant B's promoted correction MEM-CORR-B-WEIGHTED-STAGE-QUOTA-001 and recorded the joint verified outcome MEM-OUT-A-WEIGHTED-PARTITION-VERIFIED-001 (21.0% global -> 49.5% uniform 64-slot -> 68.4% weighted 256/36-slot within 2,032/2,048 slots).
